test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

The girl was __manacled__ and locked in the room.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **fettered**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"manacled"** means to be restrained or shackled, typically with handcuffs or similar restraints. (हथकड़ी लगाना)

 
 
• **Example: **The prisoners were manacled and led to their cells.
 
 
 
• **"Fettered" **refers to being restrained with chains or shackles, especially around the ankles. (बेड़ी लगाना)
 
 
• **Example: **The captives were fettered to prevent any escape attempts.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **fettered**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Unfastened** (खुला हुआ): Not fastened or secured.

 
 
• **Example:** The door was left unfastened, allowing the wind to blow it open.
 
 
 
• **Liberated** (मुक्त करना): Set free from a situation, especially imprisonment or oppression.
 
 
• **Example:** The soldiers were liberated after the peace treaty was signed.
 
 
 
• **Unbinded** (खोलना): Not bound or tied up.
 
 
• **Example:** She unbinded the ropes that were holding the parcel together.

The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Benefic
